name: Aquatint
summary: Rosin dust is melted onto a copper plate, and acid bites round each grain. The print has a soft tone like a wash. The artist controls the tone with varnish and a burnisher, so the print has a grey speckled grain.

philosophy.core_thesis: A bitten grain of rosin gives a copper plate the soft tone of a wash. An etched line can then sit on a brush-like ground.
design_principles: Etch the contour first, then add the rosin ground and bite the tone areas in timed baths.
Make the tone in steps: stop out the lightest area first and bite the darkest area longest, with 3–6 steps in all.
Keep the grain visible as a speckle, about 100–150 grains an inch.
Lift the highlights with a burnisher or a scraper; do not paint them in.
Print in one warm black or sepia, and leave a plate mark round the image.
Keep the edge of each tone area hard where the stopping-out varnish stopped the acid.
anti_patterns: A smooth digital gradient with no grain
Clean vector line work with no etched bite
Heavy hatching that replaces the wash tone

process.matrix: Copper plate with rosin ground over etched line
process.image_making: Line etched first; rosin dust fused; tones bitten in timed acid baths with stopping-out; burnishing and scraping lift lights

inks.strategy: One warm black or sepia intaglio ink, wiped by hand; a second or third ink only in colour prints.

screening.rule: Make each tone with a rosin grain of about 120 grains an inch; bite longer for a darker step.

registration.rule: One plate prints the image; a colour print needs a plate for each ink, and the paper can shift 0.5 mm between passes.

substrate.stock: Dampened laid or wove paper, cream.
substrate.finish: Soft, with some tooth, pressed into the plate.

surface.impression: A plate mark of 3–6 mm with a bevelled edge; the ink sits in the grain and stands a little above the paper.
surface.sheen: Matt to semi-matt; the ink is rich where the tone is deep.
surface.texture: A fine speckle in the tone areas, and a smooth line where the plate is etched.

emotion.target_response: Sombre, soft drama: the viewer sees a grey brush wash, with the weight of a night scene or a ruin.

use_cases: album and book covers with a night mood
avoid_when: The image needs bright colour or a crisp graphic line.
The design needs a long run with no loss of tone.

modifiers.how: Drop the tone ground, keep the etched line and add cross-hatching for the shadow.
Rock the whole plate so that the darks are deep, and scrape the lights.
